subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu support a documented attachment-content opt-out, and should the canonical option be Feishu-only or shared across channels?
rationale: The reported key is not a documented or schema-backed contract, so the remaining work is a product/config policy choice rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media downloads and switches file messages to placeholder-only context when enabled.

options.title: Design Shared Media Policy
options.body: Pause this issue for a broader channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want one option shape across Feishu and other media-capable channels.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Clarify that Feishu currently supports media size limits but not file-content suppression, leaving current download behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media downloads and switches file messages to placeholder-only context when enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: PR 47968 is the strongest recent Feishu media/docs ownership signal for the specific policy surface.
